gloss: giving up; throwing in the towel; at a loss

definitions.gloss: giving up; being at a loss; throwing in the towel
definitions.explanation: A state of having exhausted all options and being unable to do anything more about a situation. Often expressed with a gesture of raising both hands in surrender.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧お{手上|てあ}げ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧お{手上|てあ}げ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I give up on this problem.
I'm at a complete loss with his stubbornness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{直|なお}らなくて→直る：00735_naoru⟧、お{手上|てあ}げ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: No matter what I try, I can't fix it - I'm completely stuck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かなくて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧お{手上|てあ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The child wouldn't listen at all, and the parents looked completely helpless.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
お (honorific prefix) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hands) + ⟦{上|あ}げ→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (raising)
Literally "raising the hands" - the gesture of surrender. The お here is frozen into the word: there is no plain form 手上げ, so the prefix is not optional and adds no politeness.

USAGE:
Used when someone has tried everything and has no options left. It is a noun, and normally stands as a predicate with ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ or です rather than taking a verb of its own. The thing that defeats you is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, usually followed by ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・お{手上|てあ}げ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ - I give up; I am at a loss
・お{手上|てあ}げ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ - a state of having run out of options
・〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{手上|てあ}げ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ - I am at a loss with ~

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦{万策尽|ばんさくつ}きる→万策尽きる：20140_bansakutsukiru⟧ - to have exhausted every option (formal, written)
・⟦どうしようもない→どうしようもない：18862_doushiyoumonai⟧ - there is nothing to be done (about the situation itself)
・⟦{降参|こうさん}→降参：15127_kousan⟧ - to give in, to surrender (to an opponent, or playfully in a game)
・⟦あきらめる→あきらめる：01813_akirameru⟧ - to give up, as an act of will; お{手上|てあ}げ describes the helpless state rather than the decision

REGISTER:
Casual and common in everyday conversation. It is light rather than despairing - often said with a wry smile about a stubborn person, a broken appliance, or a problem beyond one's skill - so it is not the word for serious defeat or grief.
